approved_numeric_targets: No new large-collection numeric targets approved; existing maintained 128-file/600-second objective remains. #960 closeout timing shortfall is explicitly approved in comment 6102101195; #964 owns remediation.

workload_families.measure: exact single collection FTP or client custody, final root, verified independent recovery
workload_families.avoid: using separate small collections as a substitute for a single large exact collection

workload_families.measure: archive-only index rebuild, search pages and exact result parity
workload_families.avoid: assuming same-document co-residence establishes member attribution

workload_families.measure: shared verified snapshot selection with unique exact member scope and full recorded history
workload_families.avoid: omitting required recorded history or counting a cache hit as independent verified authority

workload_families.measure: exact dense causal relationships and complete requested results
workload_families.avoid: demanding linear time in member count when the lawful result is itself quadratic

workload_families.measure: one real input collection through accepted plan, target, derived collection, lineage, settlement and replay
same exact lifecycle with materially distinct real-duration media and metadata
workload_families.avoid: inferring real-content throughput from quarter-second silent WAVs

workload_families.measure: complete enumeration, scoped retrieval, independent recovery, interruption and repeatable restart

growth_objective: Linear useful-work growth on sparse workloads in required bytes, unique records, real relationships and requested results; no hidden per-member multiplication. Index/ordering and online graph costs must be stated and justified, not silently accepted. An artificially expanded internal table is not necessary output.

acceptance_direction.normative_bounds: operation-owned; dimensions, cost model, assumptions and approved exceptions
acceptance_direction.linear_default: ordinary byte streaming and collection traversal
acceptance_direction.evidence: algorithmic accounting plus maintained-implementation work counts, adversarial and boundary tests
acceptance_direction.qualification_strategy: distinct growth regimes rather than mandatory full lifecycles at every cardinality
acceptance_direction.large_sizes: research/design envelope; retain selected large integration witnesses when needed
acceptance_direction.existing_proof_replacement: requires equivalent coverage and owning approval
